title: Blue Sky exhibit
content: This weekend theNorman Rockwell Museumin Stockbridge, Massachussetts opens an exhibition of the art of Blue Sky Studios, the folks that brought us “Ice Age,” “Robots,” and the maniac squirrel named Scrat.On Saturday, June 11, starting at 6:00 there will be an opening party at the museum with co-founder/director Chris Wedge and character designer Peter de Sève.The exhibit includes storyboards, character designs, backgrounds, and 3D maquettes, both digital and traditional. It will continue through October 31.------Blue Sky exhibit at the Rockwell MuseumFacebook pageScrat from "Ice Age," TM & ©2010 Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
